trainer/32228.htm.text: Master Medeia: Welcome to Goddard Castle Town. I am Master Medeia of the Kamael Guild. If you can obey my orders without question or objection, then perhaps I can train you. Ready to begin?

trainer/32228-noteach.htm.text: Master Medea: I do not know why you have come to me, but you are mistaken in thinking I can help you. I teach only Kamael Warders, Arbalesters and Soul Breakers. You must find someone else to teach you!

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/3-01.htm.text: Master Medea: I knew you would come to me. Information is my business, after all. During my mission, I have uncovered the existence of a secret about the hidden power of our race. Looking into it further, I obtained this Resonance Amulet by defeating an evil sorcerer... But it is not perfect, corru…

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/3-05.htm.text: Master Medea: Excellent! You have brought the Divine Stone of Wisdom! Now I can use it to repair the damaged Resonance Amulet. This will take some time...

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/3-04.htm.text: Master Medea: Go get the Divine Stone of Wisdom either from the Ketra Orcs or the Varka Silenos. Only then will this Resonance Amulet work.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/3-06.htm.text: Master Medea: Go to the Tablet of Vision north of the Varka Silenos.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/3-02.htm.text: Master Medea: Gain the trust of the Ketra orcs and obtain the Divine Stone of Wisdom from them. You can also obtain it from the Varka Silenos. Either is fine.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/3-03.htm.text: Master Medea: Gain the trust of the Varka Silenos and obtain the Divine Stone of Wisdom from them. You can also obtain it from the Ketra Orcs. Either is fine.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/3-07.htm.text: Master Medea: According to my investigations, this Resonance Amulet can be repaired with the Divine Stone of Wisdom possessed by both Ketra Orcs and the Varka Silenos. But I cannot leave here. I know you are on a quest to find the Tablets, so this is a task well suited for you. Both the Ketra Orcs …

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/3-08.htm.text: Master Medea: It worked! Now take this repaired Resonance Amulet to the Tablet of Vision north of the Varka Silenos stronghold. Good luck!

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
